title: RICE AND BEEF CROQUETTES
instructions: --To use up cold meat economically combine two cups of chopped beef or mutton with two cups of freshly boiled rice. Season well with salt,  pepper,  onion juice, a large teaspoon of minced parsley, and a teaspoon of lemon juice. Pack on a large plate and set away to cool. After the mixture is cold, shape into croquettes, dip into beaten egg, roll in fine crumbs and fry in smoking hot fat.
